title: Closed-immersion base change is cover-dense and locally fully faithful
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Write $b:X_{\mathrm{Et}}\to Z_{\mathrm{Et}}$ for base change on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Then: (1) every object of $Z_{\mathrm{Et}}$ is covered by arrows from objects $b(V)$; (2) for every arrow $h:b(V)\to b(V\prime)$, the sieve on $V$ of arrows $a:W\to V$ for which $h\circ b(a)=b(c)$ for some $c:W\to V\prime$ has covering image on $b(V)$; (3) for any parallel $a,a\prime:V\to V\prime$ with $b(a)=b(a\prime)$, the sieve of arrows $c:W\to V$ with $a\circ c=a\prime\circ c$ has covering image on $b(V)$. Thus $b$ is cover-dense, locally full and locally faithful with respect to the small etale topology on $Z$. Locality here is measured on $Z$, without asserting density for the original topology on $X$.

source.place: Lemmas lemma-closed-immersion-almost-essentially-surjective and lemma-closed-immersion-almost-full; the third assertion is the open agreement locus. Existing proofs: lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/UpperLowerStar/ClosedImmersion.lean, Scheme.Hom.isCoverDense_etale_of_isClosedImmersion, Scheme.Hom.isLocallyFull_etale_of_isClosedImmersion and Scheme.Hom.isLocallyFaithful_etale_of_isClosedImmersion.

proof.text: For an etale $Z$-scheme $W$ and $w\in W$, apply [lemma-openclosed-etale-lifts-locally]: an open neighbourhood of $w$ is the base change of an etale $X$-scheme. These opens give the covering in (1).

For (2), put $P=V\times_XV\prime$. The graph of $h$ is an open subscheme of $P_Z$, since it is a section of an etale projection. The closed immersion $P_Z\to P$ is inducing on spaces, so this graph is the trace of an open $W\subseteq P$. The two projections of $W$ are $a:W\to V$ and $c:W\to V\prime$. The graph gives a section of $a_Z$, so $a_Z$ is surjective; by construction $h a_Z=c_Z$. This single arrow lies in the lifting sieve and its image covers $V_Z$. These are exactly the graph and projection constructions in the existing isLocallyFull proof.

For (3), the agreement locus of the two $X$-morphisms $a,a\prime$ into the etale $X$-scheme $V\prime$ is open in $V$: it is the inverse image of the open diagonal. The projection $V_Z\to V$ factors through it because $a_Z=a\prime_Z$. Therefore its base change to $Z$ has a section onto $V_Z$, and the image of the equalizer sieve covers. This is the construction in the existing isLocallyFaithful proof.
